target.source_claim: At cylinder energy two, the split free pure-Weyl BV block has an explicit strong deformation retract onto a ten-dimensional zero-differential physical block.
target.source_scope: The algebraic D-finite SO(4)-finite split fixture in bridge/certificates/free_bv_complex.json, not the complete field-derived gauge-fixed BV domain and not a quantum classical-import freeze.
target.formal_statement: For the displayed finite free Z-modules C=Z^230 and H=Z^10, the matrices q:C->C, h:C->C, j:H->C, and p:C->H satisfy q^2=0, pj=1_H, jp=1_C-qh-hq, h^2=0, hj=0, ph=0, qj=0, and pq=0. Consequently j and p induce mutually inverse cohomology isomorphisms H(C,q)=H, and scalar extension gives the same SDR over every nonzero unital commutative ring.
target.target_level: one fixed finite exact classical BV block

foundational_classification.encoding: Fixed finite sequences of natural-number indices and integer coefficients encoded by primitive-recursive pairing; negative coefficients occur only when comparing I-qh-hq and can be normalized as differences of natural matrices.
foundational_classification.statement: PRA suffices to verify the closed bounded case split and all integer matrix equalities in this certificate. No comprehension axiom or infinite-set existence principle is used by the displayed proof.
why_pra_is_sufficient: All dimensions and interval endpoints are fixed numerals no larger than 230.
Expansion of the four interval maps, sparse composition, and equality are primitive-recursive bounded computations.
The mathematical proof is a finite case split: every basis coordinate is exactly one contractible source, contractible target, or physical coordinate.
The cohomology conclusion follows from the displayed SDR equations by equational module algebra; no kernel basis, complement, maximal principle, or limiting argument is invoked.

apparent_dependencies_avoided: extension of a linearly independent set to a basis
avoidance_classification.replacement: The coordinate projection p, inclusion j, and contracting homotopy h are retained explicitly and checked directly.
avoidance_classification.precise_boundary: This proves avoidance for the displayed energy-2 split normal form. It neither proves that every presentation of its source construction avoids these principles nor classifies infinite-dimensional BV cohomology.

module.coefficient_ring: Z, followed by scalar extension to any nonzero unital commutative ring

nodes.statement: Ten contiguous field slices partition the 230 full coordinates.
Four equal-length source-target interval pairs define q forward and h backward with coefficient one.
The remaining interval [180,190) defines j and p as coordinate inclusion and projection.
Sources, targets, and physical coordinates are pairwise disjoint and exhaust [0,230).
j and p induce mutually inverse maps H(C,q)<->H with H carrying zero differential.
Because the identities have integer coefficients and no division, tensoring with any nonzero unital commutative ring preserves the SDR.
The cohomology result uses the explicit SDR rather than an existential complement, rank/nullspace, Hahn-Banach, or separation argument.
